nodes.rationale: No reference to 'RatoAds'/'RatoAds Miner' may remain in code or UI.

nodes.label: Primeiro MVP (detecção + extração + domínio)
nodes.rationale: MVP prioritizes detection, extraction and domain over the full SaaS; implemented sequentially Fase 01 -> 06.

nodes.label: CreativeService
nodes.rationale: Downloads only directly accessible creatives; otherwise shows 'Não foi possível obter o arquivo diretamente.' and 'Abrir criativo'.

nodes.label: MetaAdsLibraryAdapter
nodes.rationale: Isolates Meta DOM selectors so DOM changes are contained; mitigates risk of Meta changing the DOM.

nodes.label: Supabase Auth + JWT
nodes.rationale: Short-lived access token (~1h) with rotating refresh; extension never stores password; final token storage decision deferred to Fase 08.

nodes.norm_label: dominio nao encontrado / url com redirect

nodes.label: Campo ausente (data, domínio, status)
nodes.rationale: Meta fields are best-effort and may be null by design; never invent fallback data.

nodes.label: Limitações conhecidas
nodes.rationale: Best-effort Meta fields remain null (never invent data); redirect domains followed only when accessible; Meta protections (CAPTCHA/login) not bypassed.

nodes.norm_label: carousel ad fixture (pacotesviagem, inactive with stop date)

nodes.label: Missing ID fixture (no Library ID, parser must return null)
nodes.norm_label: missing id fixture (no library id, parser must return null)
nodes.rationale: Parser must not invent the ad ID.

nodes.label: Missing Domain fixture (l.php without u param)
nodes.norm_label: missing domain fixture (l.php without u param)
nodes.rationale: destinationUrl/domain must be null; never invent a destination.

nodes.label: Active Ad fixture (SupremeFit, pt-BR abbreviated date)
nodes.norm_label: active ad fixture (supremefit, pt-br abbreviated date)
nodes.rationale: runningDays = today - start when no stop date.

nodes.label: Inactive Ad fixture (AguaDeNoz, 106 running days)
nodes.rationale: runningDays = stop - start.

nodes.label: Multiple Ads fixture (3 isolated cards)
nodes.rationale: A malformed card must not leak data into other cards; each card extracted in isolation.

nodes.label: Dynamic Content fixture (scroll-injected cards + non-ad noise)
nodes.norm_label: dynamic content fixture (scroll-injected cards + non-ad noise)
nodes.rationale: Parser does not depend on prior state; non-ad noise ignored by detection.

nodes.label: Incomplete Ad fixture (no ID/dates/platforms/destination)
nodes.rationale: Parser must not break or invent fields; status = unknown (absence != inactive).

nodes.label: HTML fixtures (public Ads Library structure snapshots, A/B DOM versions)
nodes.norm_label: html fixtures (public ads library structure snapshots, a/b dom versions)
nodes.rationale: A/B fixture versions simulate DOM changes to validate parser resilience; never use proprietary reference-tool content.

nodes.label: MetaAdsLibraryAdapter
nodes.rationale: Only module that knows Meta's DOM; if Meta changes markup only this module is updated.

nodes.label: Platform Decoupling Principle
nodes.rationale: Adapter layer isolates Meta mining logic so the system is not locked to Meta; enables future Google/TikTok/Pinterest.

nodes.label: packages/shared input validation
nodes.rationale: Centralized input validation reused by extension and backend.

nodes.label: Comunicação Extensão ↔ Backend (HTTPS, Bearer header, validated payloads)
nodes.norm_label: comunicacao extensao ↔ backend (https, bearer header, validated payloads)
nodes.rationale: Tokens only in headers, never query strings; pending-operation queue with silent re-auth if token expires mid-scroll.

nodes.label: Postgres Row Level Security (RLS)
nodes.rationale: Defense in depth: RLS plus user_id scoping isolates each user's offers, notes and favorites.

nodes.label: Security threat mitigations (XSS, CSRF, SQLi, malformed URL, token exposure, rate limit)
nodes.norm_label: security threat mitigations (xss, csrf, sqli, malformed url, token exposure, rate limit)

nodes.label: Privacidade (coleta mínima, sem credenciais da Meta)
nodes.norm_label: privacidade (coleta minima, sem credenciais da meta)
nodes.rationale: Only public ads, basic user data and saved offers collected; no Meta passwords/cookies/tokens; extension only accesses facebook.com/ads/library/* and CaçaOferta API.

nodes.label: ADRs Segurança (JWT, RLS, CORS whitelist, centralized validation)
nodes.norm_label: adrs seguranca (jwt, rls, cors whitelist, centralized validation)
nodes.rationale: JWT yes; RLS for defense in depth; CORS whitelist of dashboard + extension origin; input validation centralized in packages/shared.

nodes.label: MutationObserver + debounce + WeakSet
nodes.rationale: Incremental detection of dynamically loaded content.

nodes.label: Real Data, Never Invented Principle
nodes.rationale: Missing fields stay null/unavailable; no fictitious data presented as real.

nodes.label: Incremental Detection Strategy
nodes.rationale: Process only new/changed elements: MutationObserver, debounce/throttle, WeakSet registry, ID map dedup, batch queue, event delegation, post-hydration re-observation.

nodes.label: Resilient Multi-Signal Parser / Rule Engine
nodes.rationale: Does not depend on a single Meta CSS class; ordered candidate selectors per field; unavailable field = null; never invent data.

nodes.label: normalizeDomain
nodes.rationale: Strips scheme, www, query, fragments, paths, lowercases, handles IDN/punycode and trailing dot; invalid URLs return null; subdomains preserved when relevant.

nodes.label: Domain Search Flow
nodes.rationale: Empty results shown honestly; never fabricate results.

nodes.label: CaçaOferta Estratégia de Testes
nodes.rationale: A feature is only done when it passes real tests, not just when it appears in the UI.

nodes.label: Incremental ad detection (MutationObserver + WeakSet + queue + debounce)
nodes.norm_label: incremental ad detection (mutationobserver + weakset + queue + debounce)
nodes.rationale: Batch, throttle/debounce, WeakSet and queue mitigate performance issues with many DOM mutations.

nodes.label: SavedAd
nodes.rationale: UNIQUE(user_id, ad_library_id) is the natural dedup key; platform ad_library_id is stable, superior to relying on ad_id uuid.

nodes.label: DEV_USER_ID
nodes.rationale: Temporary dev user used when no real auth exists; in production resolveCurrentUser returns 401.

nodes.label: CaçaOfertaSidebar
nodes.rationale: Sidebar reuses the FASE 03 DomainIndex/searchByDomain pipeline (no second implementation); CSS isolated in Shadow DOM so no global styles leak onto Meta; searches only the local session index, never claims coverage of the full Meta base.

nodes.label: packages/shared
nodes.rationale: Single source of truth for contracts used by extension and API.

nodes.label: manifest.json (Manifest V3)
nodes.rationale: Minimal permissions: storage, sidePanel; tabs/scripting only if needed.

nodes.label: Supabase (Auth + Postgres + RLS)
nodes.rationale: Scalable auth and database without own infra.

nodes.label: Environment Variables (DATABASE_URL, SUPABASE_*, VITE_API_URL)
nodes.rationale: DATABASE_URL and SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY must never appear in React, Vite client, extension, content script or public service worker code.

nodes.label: Prisma Migration (schema.prisma)
nodes.rationale: Never set DATABASE_URL with fake credentials or run destructive commands; with a placeholder the flow is covered by in-memory tests (251 extension, 19 API).

nodes.label: Chrome Extension Architecture (MV3)
nodes.rationale: Modular; avoids concentrating all logic in a single content script; parsing, observation and UI never in one file.

nodes.label: HTTPS + JWT Bearer Communication
nodes.rationale: Simple, stateless and secure in MV3.

nodes.label: Row Level Security
nodes.rationale: Every table restricted by user_id = auth.uid(); Ad/Domain catalog readable by authenticated users; never SERVICE_ROLE_KEY in public frontend.

nodes.label: AuthSession
nodes.rationale: Manages session token (signed/expirable in storage.local), never passwords.

nodes.label: chrome.storage.local
nodes.rationale: Never stores Meta passwords, cookies or tokens.

nodes.label: CreativeService
nodes.rationale: Download creatives only when directly accessible and permitted; otherwise show fallback and 'Abrir criativo'.
